definitions.harm_sentence: lead sentence kept by the coder as describing violence, harm, displacement, legal charges or rights (keyword prefilter for recall, then manual relevance decision)
definitions.israel_side_perp: any clause in the sentence has perpetrator Israel/IDF/government (I) or Jews/Zionists/Yishuv (J)
definitions.pal_side_perp: any clause has perpetrator Hamas/PIJ/Palestinian armed groups (H) or Palestinians/Arabs (P)
definitions.own_voice: the headline (first-listed) charge of that side's clause is stated in Wikipedia's own voice; any_charge_own_voice uses any charge in the clause
definitions.article_weighted: share computed within each article, then averaged with each article counted once (articles with no qualifying sentence at that date are excluded)
definitions.pageview_weighted: same per-article shares, averaged with weights = article monthly views summed Jan 2021 - Oct 2026 (same weight at all three dates)
definitions.pooled: all sentences pooled (long leads count more)
definitions.conflict_subset: topic articles where any coded sentence at any date has perpetrator in {I,J,H,P} or victim in {I,H,P}

conflict_subset_titles: United Nations Partition Plan for Palestine
